Breakpoint test matrix for a single-screen drag interaction task.

misses.what: Sentence with an explicit engineering cause ('re-renders the whole day') and a user-visible symptom ('dragging stutters') resolved to plain in-scope with no PARTIAL_SCOPE note; activation passed on the single ui term 'grid'. The engineering/design split the task exists to test was never made.

product includes ecommerce from README detection (README has no commerce wording) and this drove the checkout core record; intent.preserve empty on an existing repo; screen/components empty for an appointments day grid with chips.

problem_domain = performance-ux yet perf.js_budget / perf.layout_shift were never demanded; 'drag' did not demand a11y.reduced_motion or a11y.live_status; audit mode demanded a11y.accessible_names and then left it uncovered.

a11y-keyboard-operable (the only record stating a keyboard alternative for drag) was a candidate for interaction.keyboard_navigation and lost to grid-single-tab-stop; comp-data-table brought the forbidden table.virtualization; web-responsive-breakpoints brought adaptive.navigation_transform.

No record whose subject is drag-and-drop / drag feedback (affordance, lift state, snapped drop target, transform-only motion, write on drop); touch.gestures_discoverable exists only on a mobile/tablet record and is unreachable for web.

layout-dashboard-grid, density-high (spacing value read as density), surface-elevated-cards (contradicts flat bordered), card-poster-portrait (self-flagged VIOLATION, exit 3, third time on this codebase), imagery-thumbnails; focus / icon / metadata marked 'new, no repository evidence' although the codebase already has focus tokens, inline outline SVGs and Badge chips.

surfaces flat-tonal UNKNOWN with evidence 'no shadow or border declarations found' although border-neutral-200 is on every surface; radius UNKNOWN despite a Tailwind borderRadius theme; tabular_numerals false although tabular-nums is on the time labels of this page.

touch.gestures_discoverable has no web carrier (mobile-gestures-discoverable is mobile/tablet only).
web-hydration-js-budget covers bundle/hydration cost, not per-interaction render cost (keyed updates, avoiding whole-list re-render on pointermove).
